name: Merazuka Rena
source:
The protagonist's childhood friend. She used to have a neat appearance but made her debut as a gyaru in a very flashy way. She is kind and playful.

She is jealous by the relationship between the protagonist and Mitomo, however, she tries hard to bring them together...
